$comment: Registry for the model benchmark workflow (.github/workflows/eval-benchmark.yml), separate from e2e/matrix.json so adding a benchmark model never adds a CI check. `models` run every listed fixture `attempts` times against the local world; each id must exist in the AI Gateway catalog, which pins its release. `mockWorlds` run each fixture once with mock models (`local`, or a world with a package in e2e/matrix.json). `judge` is fixed per registry revision. `concurrency.legs` caps live legs running at once (gateway load); `concurrency.evalsPerLeg` is passed to `eve eval --max-concurrency` on every leg, overriding a fixture's own maxConcurrency, so evals do not share a runner. Both change measured latency, and each run's manifest records them. See research/model-benchmark-tracking.md.
